dcaf36.conditions: nbx.tuning=1 enables the initial MPI_Barrier in the Map NBX (UPstreamWrapping.txx ~line 940), so no call c+1 size message can reach a rank still polling in call c's NBX loop
dcaf36.reasoning: Pstream::exchange on Map exchanges sizes via PstreamDetail::allToAllConsensus (Map overload, src/Pstream/mpi/UPstreamWrapping.txx): Issend, then MPI_Iprobe(ANY_SOURCE, tag+1867), then Recv from the probed source, then Ibarrier. The data exchange that follows uses specific-source receives with tag 1. Without the barrier, a fast rank could Issend the sizes for call c+1 while its ring successor is still polling for call c's Ibarrier, and that probe would take the wrong call's size, which overwrites the size or leaves it missing. That gives wrong lengths or a truncation abort. With -opt-switch nbx.tuning=1, tuning_NBX_>0, so every NBX starts with a blocking MPI_Barrier before any Issend. No rank can send call c+1 sizes until all ranks have left call c (its NBX and its waitRequests). Within one call, Issend completes only once the message is received, so the Ibarrier implies every size message has been consumed. The probe-then-recv pair is single-threaded and keyed by source and tag. Matching is deterministic.
